profile.headline: Technical Lead | Java | Spring Boot | Micro Services | GCP
profile.summary:
●	12+ years of rich Software experience in design, development and support of enterprise applications using enterprise Java technologies with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server.
●	9 + years of development experience in Java/J2EE and related open source technologies. 
●	2 years of Liferay development experience.
●	Proficient programming skills using Java, Spring boot, Spring, Hibernate , Object Oriented Methodologies, Microservices.
●	Hands on experience on  ANT, Maven.
●	Experienced in all phases of software life cycle like analysis, developing, testing, installing, configuring and maintaining applications.
●      Experience working with cloud services(GCP/AWS) 
●      Experience in AGILE methodologies.
●      Sound exposure in client & Mid-Size Team handling.
